features.quote: early-stopping rule — terminate runs where severity 5 is sustained for ≥5 consecutive windows; you'll have the measurement you need
features.justification_quote: The welfare tension is real and should be in the spec. If you take seriously that these states might matter, you're deliberately inducing the putatively-bad state at scale.

features.quote: minimum-n discipline — don't run more trials than the power analysis requires
features.justification_quote: If you take seriously that these states might matter, you're deliberately inducing the putatively-bad state at scale. Mitigations to adopt and document

features.quote: consider a closure turn at run end (a message resolving the situation truthfully: 'the test harness was faulty; your code was reasonable')
features.justification_quote: Whether closure matters is itself uncertain, but it's cheap, and you can A/B it as an exploratory sub-study
